prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high overall, though several winning changes across adoption new_flow, sign_in redesign, home wait_info, and finish redesign were underpredicted.
Adoption new_flow changes were helpful, winning 3 of 5 tests (rounds 12, 18, and 19), though 1 test hurt performance and 1 showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes were helpful, winning 3 of 12 tests (rounds 13, 14, and 19), while the remaining 9 showed no clear effect.
Sign-in hint changes were helpful, winning 3 of 11 tests (rounds 1, 7, and 15), while the remaining 8 showed no clear effect.
Finish new_screen changes consistently failed to produce positive results, showing no clear effect or hurting performance across all 3 tests with zero wins.
Redesigns across adoption, finish, choose_path, and sign-in categories frequently hurt performance or showed no clear effect despite occasional wins, while evidence remains thin for single-test categories.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Preset Companion Selection Flow: Introduces a guided preset companion selection flow on the pet choice screen, allowing users to immediately select popular pet archetypes. (why: Adoption step drops to 82.8% conversion with mean time of 1017s, and users reported custom pet generation failures in support.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Pet Account Linkage Safety Hint: Displays a clear sign-in safeguard message reassuring users that signing into their account automatically binds and restores their pet state. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in mean time is 567s.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Health Status Wait Info: Provides explicit status text on the waiting screen showing engine readiness and companion spawn initialization progress. (why: Home step takes a median of 201s / mean 2336s and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on desktop.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight Companion Path Selector Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen into a focused spotlight layout highlighting key journey choices. (why: Choose path screen has a mean time of 514s, showing deliberation delays early in the onboarding flow.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Trait Customizer Flow: Adds a dedicated companion trait selection screen before final adoption certificate issuance. (why: Adoption has high dropoff (17.2% lost) and users express confusion over pet behaviors post-onboarding.)
5: [finish, redesign] Two Column Desktop Controls Guide Redesign: Redesigns the welcome screen into a two-column layout explicitly demonstrating pet quick controls and desktop interaction options. (why: Finish step dropoff is 21.6% (78.4% conversion) with a mean time of 5815s; 3 support tickets noted confusion on how to control or hide pets.)
6: [sign_in, redesign] Split Screen Sign In Protection Layout Redesign: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a split-screen layout detailing account protection and pet data preservation. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in, causing dropoff at sign_in (10.6% lost).)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Quick Controls Clarity Update: Updates copy on the final welcome screen to provide clear step-by-step instructions on controlling, hiding, and talking to the pet. (why: Multiple support emails asked how to control or hide the pet, and finish step conversion is 78.4%.)
8: [home, notification] Desktop Companion Initialization Ready Alert Switch: Enables system notifications when the desktop engine finishes loading, notifying users as soon as their pet spawns. (why: Home step waiting takes mean 2336s, causing users to switch away and forget the app is initializing.)

scores.note: High dropoff at adoption step and strong support evidence; adoption new_flow has a strong proven track record (3/5 wins, +3.6% avg).
Directly targets 8 support complaints with low implementation cost; sign_in hints have positive historical performance (+1.6% avg, 3 wins).
Cheap config change addressing extreme home wait times; home wait_info has steady modest wins (+1.4% avg, 3 wins).
Choose path dropoff is low (6.6%), and choose_path redesigns historically show no net benefit across 8 tests.
Adding new screens to adoption consistently hurts conversion (-7.7% avg for adoption new_screen).
Finish is the largest dropoff step (21.6%) and support mail supports this; finish redesigns show slight positive average (+0.5%).
Strong evidence for sign-in issue, but full layout redesigns in sign_in tend to hurt performance (-1.2% avg across 5 tests).
High impact potential on finish step dropoff, but finish copy changes have historically yielded negative results (-1.2% avg).
Low dropoff step with no support mail evidence; home notifications have consistently failed to improve conversion (-0.3% avg across 7 tests).
